WM Phoenix Open Transportation: The People's Open VIP Guide

The WM Phoenix Open is not just a golf tournament. It is the biggest party in professional golf. With hundreds of thousands of spectators over the week, the famous 16th hole stadium and Old Town Scottsdale's nightlife, transportation can make or break your Phoenix Open. Here is how to do it right, with the vehicles and rates we actually book.

Why the Phoenix Open Is Different

Other PGA stops value whisper-quiet galleries. The Phoenix Open embraces the noise:

  • 16th Hole Stadium: Thousands of fans packed into an enclosed par 3
  • Peak days: Six-figure daily attendance
  • Saturday: One of the largest single-day sporting crowds in Arizona
  • Nightlife: Old Town Scottsdale turns into golf's biggest after-party

TPC Scottsdale Logistics

The Venue

Tournament headquarters spans TPC Scottsdale's Stadium and Champions courses in North Scottsdale near Hayden and Bell Roads.

  • From Old Town: north on Scottsdale Road or the 101, far slower during the tournament
  • General parking: A long shuttle ride or walk from the course
  • Premium parking: sold separately by the tournament

Transportation Challenges

Tournament week transforms North Scottsdale. Hayden Road gridlocks from early morning, and rideshare staging sits far from the gates.

The VIP Transportation Difference

Our chauffeurs work the tournament every day of the week:

Drop-Off Access

We use the designated drop-off zones that cut walking distance, and we know which gate makes sense for your tickets.

Flexible Scheduling

The Phoenix Open runs rain or shine, early tee times to late finishes. Your chauffeur adjusts to when you actually want to leave, not a fixed schedule.

Local Expertise

Our drivers know TPC Scottsdale year-round, not just in February. Every access road, every alternative route, every exit.

Rates are hourly. 7+ hours earns 1 free hour, 12+ hours earns 2, 15+ hours earns 3. 8% tax applies. Checkout shows exactly what is charged today and when any balance is due. Tip is optional — 10/15/20% presets at checkout. It is never added automatically.

The Party Group (15 to 28 people)

The Party Bus (28 Pax) turns tournament day into a complete experience: pre-round energy with the onboard sound system, a group arrival, a place to regroup after the 16th hole and a safe ride into Old Town afterward. Perfect for bachelor and bachelorette groups, corporate outings and friend reunions.

The Corporate Group (up to 14)

The Executive Sprinter gives clients leather seating, quiet space for conversation and a professional arrival. An 8-hour tournament day bills 7 hours (one free) for $1,015 plus 8% tax. With 14 on board that is about $73 per person.

The Small Group (up to 6)

The Luxury SUV suits couples and small groups. An 8-hour tournament day is $875 before tax ($945 with tax). Luggage and gear fit confirmed separately.

Tournament Week Services

Daily Tournament Transportation

Morning drop (7:00 to 8:00 AM): Hotel or residence pickup, drop at the best gate for your tickets, chauffeur confirms return timing.

Evening pickup (5:00 to 7:00 PM): Text-based coordination and a head start on the traffic rush.

All-day service: Your chauffeur stays with the group so you can leave for lunch, come back, or roll straight into Old Town.

Multi-Day Bookings

Thursday through Sunday gives you full tournament coverage. Friday and Saturday are the peak atmosphere days. Each day is billed as its own hourly booking.

Beyond the Course

Old Town Scottsdale Nightlife

Tournament nights light up Old Town. The stops cluster on and around Scottsdale Road. Our nightlife service covers tournament pickup, dinner, bar hopping and a safe late-night return.

Drinking on Board

Adults can drink on board. Arizona's open-container law, A.R.S. § 4-251, exempts passengers in a vehicle for hire such as a party bus or limousine. It is BYOB, everyone drinking must be 21 or older, and the driver never drinks. If anyone on board is under 21, no alcohol at all. You can read the full explainer.

Dining

The popular post-golf tables sit a short run from the course along Scottsdale Road. Reserve your table when you set the itinerary; your chauffeur handles the timing.

Sample Itineraries

The Saturday Epic (Party Bus (28 Pax))

  • 8:00 AM: Hotel pickup
  • 8:30 AM: Tournament arrival
  • All day: 16th hole, Bird's Nest, the works
  • 6:30 PM: Pickup and dinner
  • 9:00 PM: Old Town Scottsdale
  • 11:00 PM: Hotel return

That is 15 hours requested, which earns 3 free hours, so it bills 12 hours: $3,000 before tax, $3,240 with tax. Split 28 ways it is about $107 per person; 20 friends pay about $150 each for the whole day and night.

The Corporate Thursday (Executive Sprinter)

  • 8:00 AM: Guest airport pickups
  • 12:00 PM: Tournament arrival
  • 6:00 PM: Tournament departure
  • 7:00 PM: Client dinner
  • 10:00 PM: Hotel return

Fourteen hours requested bills 12 hours: $1,740 plus 8% tax.

The Casual Friday (Luxury SUV)

  • 10:00 AM: Hotel departure
  • 4:00 PM: Early exit
  • 4:30 PM: Wine tasting in Old Town
  • 7:00 PM: Dinner
  • 9:00 PM: Hotel return

Eleven hours requested bills 10 hours: $1,250 before tax, $1,350 with tax.

What to Bring

Sunscreen and a hat, comfortable shoes, light layers for cool mornings, a phone charger and cash for vendors. We provide bottled water, charging cables, climate control and storage for anything you buy at the merchandise tent.

Weather

February in Scottsdale usually means cool mornings and warm afternoons. Rain is possible but rare. The vehicle is the perfect place to shed layers or warm up.

Booking Strategy and Cancellation

Availability varies by date and by vehicle. Request a current quote for your date and we will confirm what is open.

Cancellation terms depend on your date and booking; read the cancellation policy before you book. One free date change when you ask 72 or more hours ahead. If we cancel, everything is refunded. Full details at /policies.

Many guests extend the trip with our Grand Canyon tours, Verde Valley wine tours or a round of their own with our golf transportation at Troon North, Grayhawk, Talking Stick or We-Ko-Pa. See the full WM Phoenix Open experience page for packages built around the tournament.
